source.company_summary: Our Cloud & Networking products comprise a comprehensive portfolio of optical and photonic chips, components, modules, and subsystems supplied to cloud data center operators, AI/ML infrastructure providers, and network equipment manufacturer customers who are building cloud data center and network infrastructures.
product_stack: pump lasers for optical amplifiers and passive components such as switches
higher performance VCSELs and VCSEL arrays
optical channel monitors to efficiently switch

ai_exposure.summary: The convergence of factors including the growing reliance on data transmission, the rapid adoption of AI/ML, and the increasing digitalization of society is driving expansion in cloud data centers and the demand for higher-bandwidth network solutions.

translation.company_summary: 我們的 Cloud & Networking 產品組合包括全面的光學與光子晶片、元件、模組及子系統，供應給雲端資料中心營運商、AI/ML 基礎設施提供者，以及建構雲端資料中心和網路基礎設施的網路設備製造商客戶。
product_stack: 光放大器及被動元件（如開關）用泵浦雷射
高效能 VCSELs 及 VCSEL 陣列
用於有效切換的光通道監控器

ai_exposure.summary: 包括對資料傳輸依賴增加、AI/ML 快速採用，以及社會數位化程度提升等多重因素匯聚，推動雲端資料中心擴大及對更高頻寬網路解決方案的需求。
